content.short: RubyScore provides an on-chain reputation ranking protocol.
content.description: RubyScore is an on-chain reputation platform that helps blockchain organizations discover, recognize, and reward users over time. It delivers a decentralized reputation system that is highly customizable to accommodate the diverse needs of Web3 ecosystems, protocols, and communities. Users can view Layer 2 network statistics across more than ten parameters and use these insights to strengthen trust, guide participation, and progressively improve the on-chain reputation of network participants.
